jobs.title: Finance Transformation Manager (Project Hire)
jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:
Finance Transformation Manager (Project Hire)
Req ID:
10160833
Job Description:
Finance Transformation Manager (Project Hire through April 1st 2028)

At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible, possible. The Walt Disney Company is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.

About the Role & Team

The Finance Transformation mission is to deliver technology solutions that align to business strategies while enabling enterprise efficiency and promoting cross-company collaborative innovation. The team drives competitive advantage by enhancing consumer experiences, enabling business growth, and advancing operational excellence.
The Finance Transformation Manager plays a pivotal role in coordinating and managing global finance integration and transformation efforts, contributing to the company’s Future-Fit Finance Organization. This role leads the strategy, design, and implementation of enterprise data capabilities that enable Finance Transformation across Disney Entertainment and the broader enterprise.

The position sits at the intersection of business architecture, data strategy, product ownership, technical delivery, and finance process transformation. The initial focus is implementing a Finance Data Layer, a scalable data lakehouse that provides trusted, governed, and analytics-ready data to Finance systems and applications, including Enterprise Performance Management, business intelligence reporting and analytics, and AI and machine learning use cases.

What You Will Do
- Lead the data strategy and implementation roadmap for enterprise Finance data capabilities, ensuring alignment to Finance Transformation priorities, company-wide data strategies, and long-term technology architecture.

- Drive the implementation of a Finance Data Layer / data lakehouse to support EPM, BI reporting and analytics, AI/ML applications, and other Finance platforms and services.

- Translate Finance planning, forecasting, reporting, and operational needs into business requirements, technical requirements, user stories, data product specifications, and implementation plans.

- Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, delivery managers, solution architects, engineers, analytics teams, and support operations to deliver end-to-end data solutions that are scalable, governed, and fit for business use.

- Support cross-functional project teams through the full delivery lifecycle, from data source discovery and ingestion design through modeling, transformation, validation, UAT, deployment, and operational support.

- Coordinate and guide engineering efforts required to build large-scale data platform capabilities, including ingestion pipelines, medallion architecture, dimensional models, data quality frameworks, security standards, and ready-to-use datasets.

- Define and manage platform and program priorities, balancing business value, delivery timelines, technical debt, platform stability, cost optimization, and ongoing enhancement needs.

- Establish success measures for data capabilities, including data quality, data availability, query performance, user adoption, delivery milestones, cost efficiency, and business outcomes.

- Support Finance Transformation initiatives by connecting process optimization, business capability design, and data implementation across Disney Entertainment and enterprise Finance teams.

- Communicate clearly with executive, business, functional, and technical audiences, translating complex data and technology concepts into practical decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps.

Required Qualifications & Skills

- 5+ years of progressive experience in enterprise data strategy, data platform implementation, data product delivery, Finance Transformation, or related technology transformation roles.
- Experience leading complex, cross-functional data implementation initiatives from strategy and requirements through delivery, validation, adoption, and operational support.
- Strong understanding of enterprise data platforms, modern data stack concepts, cloud data architecture, data lakehouse patterns, and scalable data pipeline delivery.
- Working knowledge of Finance processes, including planning, forecasting, reporting, performance management, financial data definitions, and the role of data in enabling modern Finance capabilities.
- Experience translating business needs into functional requirements, technical requirements, data models, source-to-target mappings, implementation plans, and user acceptance criteria.
- Experience partnering with engineers and architects on data ingestion, ETL/ELT pipelines, dimensional modeling, medallion architecture, data quality, access controls, and production-ready datasets.
- Strong project and delivery leadership skills, including roadmap development, prioritization, dependency management, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and delivery governance.
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both business and technical audiences, including senior leaders, Finance stakeholders, architects, engineers, analysts, and external partners.
- Highly collaborative, detail-oriented, deliverable-focused, and able to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex issues, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise data domains; Finance data experience strongly preferred.
- Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, SAP systems such as S/4, BW, HANA, or BDC, and EPM platforms such as Oracle EPM.
- Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI.
- Experience with data governance, master data management, metadata management, data quality frameworks, and role-based access controls.
- Familiarity with dbt, Python, Airflow, SQL, Java, CI/CD practices for data, and performance optimization for cloud data platforms.
- Experience in entertainment, streaming, media, or similarly complex global business environments.
- Formal project management, Agile, Six Sigma, consulting, PMP, MBA, CPA, or related transformation credentials are a plus.

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in any of the following areas: Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience.

The hiring range for this position in Burbank, California is $141,300.00-$172,500.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:
Legal Operations Manager
Req ID:
10158339
Job Description:
This is an office-based role in our Singapore office.

Wherever you are in the amazing world of Disney, you are contributing to the stories of our iconic brands, recognised by audiences everywhere for entertainment, information and inspiration. Innovation, imagination and inclusion are at the core of Disney, defining the experience that we deliver as well as providing the foundation of our success. The scope of our business, combined with global growth and collaboration result in an inclusive employee experience characterised by continuous learning, development and achievement.

About the Role
The Legal Operations Manager will be an integral part of the APAC Legal team, aimed at providing best-in-class legal operations management and legal practice support, and ensuring alignment across the region.

The role is responsible for auditing current systems and usage, identifying gaps, supporting the implementation of APAC legal operations initiatives and project managing change and alignment both of systems and of legal practice.

This is a front-facing role for an AI and legal technology “superuser” to help the team work more effectively and efficiently across the region and in coordination with the global Legal Operations team.

The ability to build strong internal and external relationships is critical, together with the ability to work with initiative, flexibility,  and discretion. Confidence in presenting with clarity is essential and must be comfortable actively contributing to discussion as we explore how we evolve.

The role requires a highly motivated, tenacious individual who works comfortably and autonomously. He/she will also need to demonstrate their ability to manage priorities well, possessing a strong mix of technical,  organisational and communication skills.

Responsibilities:
Legal Operations, Systems and Technology
- Audit and evaluate potential solutions to improve Disney LGA processes and provide clear recommendations.

- Develop and implement optimized processes for APAC Legal in collaboration with Global Legal Operations and relevant stakeholders.

- Support the testing of legal technology tools, including AI-enabled solutions.

- Gather use cases and requirements from APAC team members and translate them into practical business requirements.

- Organize and coordinate pilot programmes, collect user feedback and track progress of APAC legal technology initiatives.

- Work with Global Legal Operations to configure tools, develop integrations and support implementation where needed.

- Promote adoption of existing and new tools through demonstrations, training materials and APAC Legal Insider updates.

- Support lawyers in the effective use of AI research and legal technology tools.

- Monitor industry and digital trends, particularly the use of AI in legal practice, and share relevant insights with the team.

- Support Global colleagues to analyze data and prepare reports on key metrics, including contract volumes, cycle times, time savings, cost savings and return on investment.

Contract Administration and Legal Operations Support
- Lead and maintain contracts and agreements administration support, including use of online contract management tools.

- Ensure storage systems and methodology are aligned and appropriate.

- Provide a Centre of expertise for intranet resources, processes, standards, procedures, and tools.

- Support APAC section of Legal Database including ongoing updates.

- Support the team via continuous learning and development.

Requirements:
- At least 8+ years working experience, with proven track record in Legal Operations or similar.

- Law firm and/or Industry background preferred. An interest in a multinational media and entertainment environment an advantageous; experience working in a matrixed global organization highly regarded.

- Experience in managing senior stakeholders in a highly professional manner.

- Demonstrated planning skills, including project scheduling, estimating, risk identification/mitigation, and change management.

- Strong process orientation; solid understanding of project management techniques, methodologies and best practices.

- Possess a curious, analytical mindset with the strong ability to apply data and insights to drive outcomes.

- Possess business acumen and proven ability to react quickly, and plan proactively to meet project needs.

- Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills. Has the ability to influence.

- Digitally savvy.

- Results-oriented

- Strong attention to detail

- Possesses a collaborative mind-set: good at building relationships across the organization and with external partners.

Educational Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Strategy, Law or business-related field.

The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our audiences, and where all can thrive and belong. We are committed to building a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

jobs.title: General Manager - WTVD
jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:
General Manager - WTVD
Req ID:
10162256
Job Description:
Disney Entertainment’s eight-owned ABC stations are multiplatform leaders in local news and information. The only local news station with three downtown newsrooms (Raleigh/Fayetteville/Durham), ABC11 WTVD Eyewitness News provides 45.5 hours of local news every week, serving more than 1 million households in a 23-county area in North Carolina and Virginia. Eyewitness News also provides news, weather and sports information 24 hours a day on ABC11.com, the ABC11 mobile news app and the new connected TV app.

The President and General Manager of WTVD-TV is responsible for leading and advancing the local owned ABC television station in the Raleigh / Durham market, managing the strategies and teams that drive audience and growth across platforms.

This executive will be at the center of WTVD-TV’s future success, upholding our commitment to quality journalism and the communities we serve while driving modernization across the organization, prioritizing an adaptable and inclusive culture that embraces change and innovation.

The General Manager will have a clear vision for the future of WTVD-TV with the capability of communicating and executing that vision via hands-on leadership, optimism, strategic risk-taking, and focused metrics of success. He or she will be a creative thinker who generates new ideas and understands how to maximize brands and resources to achieve market leadership. This includes developing strategies that evolve the WTVD-TV brand from not only being the place to go for breaking news, but also where consumers can expect to find localized, high-quality, high-impact journalism and content.

This executive will also work directly with the ABC Owned Stations leadership and other businesses within Disney Entertainment Television, as well as The Walt Disney Company, to drive collective growth and success. The leader will focus on Robust Content Strategy, Operational Efficiencies & Innovation, and Cross-Company Partnerships.

What You Will Do:

- Direct and manage the overall operations to drive "ethical results" (meet or exceed KPIs), including established goals/objectives in ratings, audience, video, sales/revenue, market share, profit, and operating income.
- Oversee and evolve the brand to maximize its impact, relevancy, and connection with local audiences.
- In collaboration with appropriate executives, develop and implement a content strategy that attracts and engages audiences across platforms.
- Lead a premium multi-platform news organization, including a vast and diverse team of talent across many roles and disciplines.
- Oversight of the station's 24/7 broadcast and quality/technical requirements.
- Synergy with all Disney lines of business through linear, streaming, social, and digital content.
- Grow and develop unified CTV strategies to create/aggregate content for streaming platforms.
- Drive business and partnership development efforts to drive modernization and further group goals.
- Continue to identify more effective and efficient approaches to operations and processes throughout the organization.
- Represent the station in the community; develop and maintain strong relationships with community leaders.
- Seek out opportunities to contribute to the local market area for the betterment of the community.
- Recruit, develop, and retain a strong leadership team; provide guidance and coaching to maximize their performance and accelerate their professional growth.
- Champion data and analytics to drive multi-platform content, product, and platform optimization as well as accountability across the organization.
- Execute all corporate policies/objectives while maintaining the highest level of ethics and industry standards.
- Establish and maintain an innovative and highly collaborative culture atmosphere that promotes novel idea generation, open communication, respect for others, and excellence.
- Create a diverse, collaborative, fun, and stimulating work environment.
- Collaborate with other parts of OTV, Walt Disney Television, and TWDC to advance the group’s interests and leverage assets.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

- A minimum of 10 years of proven experience as a leader at a top market broadcast station.
- A participative leadership approach that fosters collaboration and innovation.
- Ability to recognize, create, and communicate priorities, strategies, market opportunities, and challenges to drive growth and performance improvement.
- Attention to detail, project management skills, and the ability to effectively lead and manage in a dynamic and challenging environment.
- Experience managing budgeting processes and strategic planning.
- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
- Legal understanding of FCC rules and regulations.
- Experience working with unions and contract negotiations.

Preferred Qualifications :

- Experience as a station general manager in a top 50 market.
- Experience leading executive teams.

Required Education :

- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

The hiring range for this position in Durham, NC is $351,100 to $470,900 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

Job Posting Title:
Intern, Project & Program Management, Disney+ - Jan to Jun 2027
Req ID:
10162098
Job Description:
This is an office-based role in our Singapore office.

Wherever you are in the amazing world of Disney, you are contributing to the stories of our iconic brands, recognised by audiences everywhere for entertainment, information and inspiration. Innovation, imagination and inclusion are at the core of Disney, defining the experience that we deliver as well as providing the foundation of our success. The scope of our business, combined with global growth and collaboration result in an inclusive employee experience characterised by continuous learning, development and achievement.

About Disney+
Disney+ is the dedicated streaming home for movies and shows from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, and more. As part of Disney’s Direct-to-Consumer and International (DTCI) segment, Disney+ is available on most internet-connected devices and offers commercial-free programming with a variety of original feature-length films, documentaries, live-action and animated series and short-form content. Alongside unprecedented access to Disney’s incredible library of film and television entertainment, the service is also the exclusive streaming home for the latest releases from The Walt Disney Studios.

About the Role
We are looking for a digitally savvy, organised, and process-oriented Project & Program Management Intern based in Singapore who is passionate about delivering outcomes. The Intern will be an integral part of the Disney+ APAC Program Management Office team, aimed at providing best-in-class program management services to help the APAC Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) team meet one of the company’s top strategic objectives; to deliver sustained DTC subscriber and revenue growth.

Primary responsibilities will be to support the delivery of key strategic initiatives in APAC in partnership with various cross-functional work streams across the APAC region.

Initiatives the intern will help support may include new partnerships, innovative business models and new exciting product features/capabilities. There is also a strong focus on process streamline in order to enable more efficient, and organised ways of working within the direct-to-consumer team.

The role requires a highly motivated, tenacious individual who works comfortably and autonomously in an exciting, fast-paced and highly matrixed environment. You will also need to demonstrate ability to manage priorities well, possessing a strong mix of organisational and communication skills.

Responsibilities:
Program/Project Strategic Initiatives
The intern will support a diverse range of strategic, high-impact initiatives across the APAC region when required. Key responsibilities include:
- Team Collaboration:  - Communicate with various APAC Regional and local cross-functional teams on new change initiatives including Product, Partnerships,  Marketing, Growth, Content, Legal, and Operations teams to achieve desired results.
- Support the APAC PMO in the preparation of presentation materials for program/project cross-functional forums.
- Ensure Sources of Truth are kept up to date
- Record minutes of meeting and help follow up on open actions.
- Set up Program collateral using Google Sheet, Airtable.

- Reporting & Communication - Help to complete and submit weekly Active APAC Programs reports.
- Support the Senior Manager with completion of the weekly APAC DTC Newsletter to leadership.
- Draft Program launch communication to leadership and team members.

- Change Control: Support in the management of Program scope and change control, escalating issues to the APAC PMO team as necessary.
- Testing: Perform and/or coordinate in-market Singapore user testing, including troubleshooting and analysis of issues to assist project stakeholders and team members.
- Problem Solving: Work cross-functionally with Disney+ stakeholders and team members to identify critical business blockers and collaborate with them to solve. Proactively identify risks and issues on projects, helping teams and stakeholders to develop risk management and issue management plans, responsible for the management and reporting of RAID items across multiple work streams.
- Support access and adoption of tools (e.g., OTT application, Google suite, Slack, Jira, Smartsheet, Airtable) for team members.
- Show commitment to improving the Program/Project management profession within the company via continuous learning and development, helping to grow the Program Management Community of Practice over time.

Process Improvement Initiatives
The intern will be expected to help with process improvement initiatives in order to enable more efficient, and organised ways of working within the APAC direct-to-consumer division. Key responsibilities include:
- Actively participate and support brainstorming sessions, business reviews and post launch reviews
- Apply strategic thinking, and problem solving ability to overcome any issues/ problems that may arise.
- Establish and roll out new templates for the Program launches in APAC.
- Document Program Management processes
- Contribute to new team member onboarding i.e documentation, process roll out, access to new tools etc.

jobs.title: Hotel Operations Director, Aulani Resort & Spa ($139,200 - $186,600)
jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:
Hotel Operations Director, Aulani Resort & Spa ($139,200 - $186,600)
Req ID:
10161042
Job Description:
Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, is more than an enchanting, family-friendly destination. We’ve combined the spirit of O`ahu with the magic of Disney to create a place where guests and cast members alike can feel the magic, can feel the spirit of the island and can truly feel welcome. Here, you’ll bring the spirit of the islands to life in every part of your role. Are you ready to join this team and make an impact?

About the Role:

The Hotel Operations Director provides strategic and operational leadership for Front Office, Recreation, and Information Technology at Aulani. This role advances exceptional guest experiences, Cast engagement, financial performance, safety, operational reliability, and continuous improvement across a complex, high-volume resort environment. The Director translates business priorities into disciplined operating plans, develops strong leadership teams, and ensures each area consistently reflects Disney’s Five Keys and Aulani’s cultural values.

The Hotel Operations Director leads multiple operational teams and leaders to deliver seamless hotel operations, balancing guest satisfaction, safety, financial performance, and technology reliability in a high-volume resort environment. This position sets strategic direction, aligns departmental plans with broader Disney Experiences goals, and mentors leaders to prioritize resources, drive continuous improvement, and uphold Disney’s service standards. This role matters because it ensures Aulani remains a creative, customer-focused, and culturally aware destination where Cast and guests experience the magic of Disney every day, requiring a strategic, team-oriented, and detail-oriented leader to be successful.

This full-time, salaried position reports to the General Manager and will be working onsite at Aulani resort on the island of Oahu, Hawaii.

Responsibilities:

- Provide strategic and operational leadership for Front Office, Recreation, and resort Information Technology operations, translating business priorities into clear operating plans for multiple related teams.
- Direct Front Office strategy and execution across arrival, departure, lobby, concierge, bell, valet, phone, and guest-services functions to ensure seamless, premium service delivery and timely recovery of complex guest concerns.
- Lead safe, engaging, and culturally relevant Recreation operations across pools, beach, water activities, cabanas, and related equipment, maintaining rigorous safety, water-quality, and regulatory standards.
- Provide executive oversight of resort Information Technology operations, infrastructure, end-user support, and technology-enabled guest experiences, ensuring system availability, cybersecurity compliance, and effective incident response in partnership with enterprise technology teams.
- Own departmental operating plans, budgets, forecasts, labor strategies, and capital priorities, using performance metrics and operational indicators to guide improvements in guest satisfaction, safety, service reliability, and financial results.
- Develop and implement strategy-oriented operating plans that align team responsibilities with Disney Experiences goals, empowering leaders to solve both immediate and long-term operational challenges.
- Build, coach, and retain a high-performing, inclusive leadership team by setting clear expectations, providing continuous coaching and feedback, and supporting career development and succession planning.
- Foster a positive, service-minded work environment that models Disney’s leadership behaviors and values, encourages creative problem solving, and ensures Cast feel respected, informed, and empowered.
- Model Disney’s Five Keys and Aulani values, including Kuleana, Mālama, Laulima, and ʻOluʻolu, in daily decisions and relationships.
- Collaborate with Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Security, Sales, Revenue Management, Facilities, and external partners to optimize the end-to-end resort experience and support integrated Disney vacation offerings.
- Oversee strategic partnerships supporting transportation, excursions, lifeguard safety, housekeeping support, parking revenue collection, and electric-vehicle charging, ensuring service quality and alignment with resort standards.
- Provide visible leadership during peak periods, critical incidents, emergency response, and business disruptions, demonstrating sound judgment, crisis leadership, and care for both guests and Cast.

Required Qualifications:

- Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in luxury hotel hospitality, resort operations, or comparable service operations, including 5+ years leading multiple teams or departments at the managerial level.
- Proven ability to envision future possibilities and create breakthrough strategies for hotel and resort operations, aligning departmental plans with Disney Experiences objectives.
- Demonstrated strength in planning and prioritizing work across multiple departments, setting organizational priorities, and allocating resources to meet financial, safety, and guest-experience goals.

jobs.description:
Job Posting Title:
Senior Manager, Finance Transformation
Req ID:
10161360
Job Description:
About the Role & Team

At The Walt Disney Company, Finance Transformation is a high-profile, cross-functional initiative to define and create the future of Finance at the Company. As our Oracle EPM program moves toward go-live, Finance is rebuilding its data foundation, connecting source finance systems through cloud platforms into our Enterprise Data Management (EDM) environment, and rethinking how that data is structured downstream for AI-enabled analysis.

We are seeking an exceptional Finance Transformation Senior Manager to own this data strategy end to end as an individual contributor. This person will define how information should move inbound from source finance systems into the finance data ecosystem, and how that same data should be structured and documented so it is usable by AI tools and agents. This is a hands-on strategy and governance role built on deep finance transformation experience and it requires the judgment and stakeholder management expected of a Finance Transformation leader.

Responsibilities and Duties of the Role

- Own the data strategy for how financial data moves from source finance systems into the enterprise’s cloud data platforms and Oracle EPM environment, reviewing each stage for accuracy, completeness, and business integrity.

- Define the enterprise data strategy for this pipeline, including business rules, data definitions, and controls, for Enterprise Technology to build and implement. This role defines the strategy, and Enterprise Technology builds against it.

- Define data quality, validation, and reconciliation standards so that data supporting planning, consolidation, and reporting can be trusted.

- Define governance principles and access management standards across finance systems and tools, establishing clear rules for who can view, edit, and approve data as it moves through the finance data ecosystem.

- Own issue resolution during go-live and early production, identifying the business impact of data discrepancies and directing them to resolution with Enterprise Technology and implementation partners.

- Define how finance data should be structured and documented downstream so it is readily and reliably usable by AI tools and agents, including clear definitions and consistent business meaning.

- Communicate data strategy, risks, and go-live readiness clearly to Finance Transformation leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, using plain language.

Required Education, Experience, Skills & Training

- 7 or more years of relevant experience leading data strategy within large-scale finance transformation or FP&A modernization programs.

- Demonstrated experience defining and managing master data management and data governance standards, including ownership, stewardship, and control practices, for enterprise financial data.

- Experience owning issue resolution for data problems during and after a major system go-live.

- Deep fluency in how FP&A operates, including chart of accounts, planning cycles, close processes

- Comfortable driving outcomes across Enterprise Technology and implementation partners through technical credibility and influence.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting data strategy and risk to finance and technology leadership.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills

- Experience defining how finance data should be organized and documented so AI agents and tools can reliably access and use it, for example through clear definitions, consistent formats, and accessible data interfaces.

- Hands-on experience with one or more of the following: Oracle EPM, Snowflake, SAP, or a comparable enterprise data management platform.

- Certification in data governance or master data management.

- Prior consulting or systems-integrator experience advising on large-scale Oracle EPM implementations.

Education

Required
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred
MBA or other advanced degree.

The Walt Disney Company (TWDC) has a diverse global portfolio of companies spanning movies, television, news, sports, games, theme parks, resorts, and more. Disney's Direct-To-Consumer (DTC) business unit, part of TWDC's Disney Entertainment segment, oversees all facets of Disney's Film and TV Streaming, including Hulu and Disney+.

This role will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

Values
You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values — acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What You Will Do

As an Associate Program Manager in the Business Operations Launch Program Management team for Disney+ , you will drive strategic initiatives across divisions by creating clarity out of chaos. You will leverage your attention to detail, multitasking ability, and critical thinking to manage complex projects, foster stakeholder relationships, and communicate effectively with leaders at all levels.

You will manage a diverse portfolio of work, including Monetization and Subscriber Growth, Content, Marketing, Data, and Legal programs. Committed to the principle of "just enough" process rigor, you will ensure transparency in program progress, risks, and dependencies.
You will collaborate closely with the Disney Entertainment group, including teams across Product + Technology, Content, Marketing, and various international business units. - Project Planning: Assist in developing detailed project plans that define scope, timelines, resource allocation, and success criteria to ensure clear and achievable objectives.

- Communication: Support the implementation of communication, monitoring, and control strategies to facilitate timely updates on project status, risks, and issues to business stakeholders.

- Risk Management: Identify operational risks, issues, dependencies, and key decision points; escalate concerns promptly to ensure proactive mitigation.

- Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain effective communication channels to manage stakeholder expectations, align priorities, and foster strong collaborative relationships across teams.

- Teamwork: Promote a collaborative team environment by influencing colleagues, supporting teamwork, and motivating cross-functional groups to achieve shared goals.

Required Qualifications & Skills

- Experience: Minimum of 3 years in program and project management within a large corporate, direct-to-consumer streaming business, or consulting firm.

- Software Literacy: Basic proficiency and understanding of the software development lifecycle.

- Global Experience: International experience preferred, demonstrating cultural awareness and adaptability in diverse markets.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, another business/tech field, or equivalent work experience.

- Collaboration: Proven track record collaborating effectively across highly matrixed, cross-functional teams to build strong partnerships and drive shared success. Skilled at managing competing priorities and stakeholders and working as a team.

- Adaptability: Demonstrates resilience, tenacity, a positive mindset and ease working in ambiguous or dynamic situations.

- Process Improvement: Experience driving business process enhancements for increased efficiency and effectiveness.
